title: DL Rakeem Nunez-Roches agrees to one-year deal with Bucs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DL Rakeem Nunez-Roches agrees to one-year deal with Bucs
sources.description: Defensive lineman Rakeem “Nacho” Nunez-Roches has agreed to a one-year deal to return to the Buccaneers, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
